children: Light AI reported an unaudited Q3 2026 net loss of $1.5M versus $5.6M a year earlier. It had $6.1M cash at September 30 and expects additional financing over the next 12 months; QuickScan development timelines have been affected.
Q3 net loss $1.5M vs $5.6M year ago
Loss narrowed substantially year over year, but the release does not provide a quarterly revenue figure.
The year-to-date loss narrowed, though continued losses and cash use leave financing needs in focus.
Cash was $6.1M at Sept. 30 vs $6.5M at Dec. 31
Cash declined while operating cash outflow was $5.2M for nine months; the company expects to need financing within 12 months.
Evidence gaps in the complete diagnostic system require further development and validation, delaying anticipated progress.
Two directors resigned; interim chair appointed
Board turnover adds governance uncertainty; John W. Meekison was appointed interim chair.

This is an early-stage healthcare technology company still developing and validating its product, with the release reporting ongoing losses and a QuickScan remediation process. Progress on system-level validation and regulatory activities, alongside securing additional financing, would be needed for a larger catalyst.
